("sem.admit_mutation.summary", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.admit_mutation.summary", "about", "admit_mutation")

("sem.admit_mutation.summary", "order", "1")

("sem.admit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is { proposalId: string }; laneSubject and sessionId come from tools/call params or the stored proposal target metadata, never tool arguments. Accepted admissions return candidate delta, projection, typedProjection, target metadata, and admission evidence. Rejected admissions are normal MCP tool errors with admission evidence. Repeated calls for the same proposal return the existing admission without appending duplicate evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "about", "commit_mutation")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "kind", "summary")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "order", "1")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "about", "commit_mutation")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is exactly one of { mutation: object } or { admissionId: string }. actor, expectedRevision, laneSubject, and sessionId come from tools/call params for direct mutation commits. expectedRevision is always the canonical witness revision precondition. admissionId commits rehydrate the accepted admission target, verify the canonical revision still matches, verify ephemeral session fingerprints still match, then append mutation and resolution evidence only. Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "isa", "SemanticDoc")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")

Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.preview_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.preview_mutation.note", "about", "preview_mutation")
("sem.preview_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.preview_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.preview_mutation.note", "text", "Input is { mutation: object }; laneSubject and sessionId come from tools/call params, not tool arguments. With no laneSubject it previews canonical state. ("sem.mcp.semanticDocCreateFactsPolicy.note", "order", "2")
("sem.mcp.semanticDocCreateFactsPolicy.note", "text", "Accepted facts must contain one new SemanticDoc subject with exactly one isa SemanticDoc, about, kind, order, and text fact, plus optional unique seeAlso refs. ("sem.admit_mutation.summary", "kind", "summary")

("sem.admit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is { proposalId: string }; laneSubject and sessionId come from tools/call params or the stored proposal target metadata, never tool arguments. Accepted admissions return candidate delta, projection, typedProjection, target metadata, and admission evidence. Rejected admissions are normal MCP tool errors with admission evidence. ("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "about", "commit_mutation")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "kind", "summary")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "order", "1")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "text", "commit_mutation is a mutating host MCP tool that commits canonical or session-lane semantic mutations directly or from an accepted admission.")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "about", "commit_mutation")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is exactly one of { mutation: object } or { admissionId: string }. actor, expectedRevision, laneSubject, and sessionId come from tools/call params for direct mutation commits. expectedRevision is always the canonical witness revision precondition. admissionId commits rehydrate the accepted admission target, verify the canonical revision still matches, verify ephemeral session fingerprints still match, then append mutation and resolution evidence only. Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.mcp.semanticDocCreateFactsPolicy.note", "order", "2")
("sem.mcp.semanticDocCreateFactsPolicy.note", "text", "Accepted facts must contain one new SemanticDoc subject with exactly one isa SemanticDoc, about, kind, order, and text fact, plus optional unique seeAlso refs. Extra predicates, duplicate subjects, malformed refs, duplicate seeAlso refs, empty text, and unsupported clusters are rejected before commit.")

("sem.admit_mutation.summary", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.admit_mutation.summary", "about", "admit_mutation")
("sem.admit_mutation.summary", "kind", "summary")
("sem.admit_mutation.summary", "order", "1")

("sem.admit_mutation.note", "about", "admit_mutation")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is { proposalId: string }; laneSubject and sessionId come from tools/call params or the stored proposal target metadata, never tool arguments. Accepted admissions return candidate delta, projection, typedProjection, target metadata, and admission evidence. Rejected admissions are normal MCP tool errors with admission evidence. Repeated calls for the same proposal return the existing admission without appending duplicate evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "about", "commit_mutation")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "kind", "summary")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "order", "1")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "text", "commit_mutation is a mutating host MCP tool that commits canonical or session-lane semantic mutations directly or from an accepted admission.")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "about", "commit_mutation")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is exactly one of { mutation: object } or { admissionId: string }. actor, expectedRevision, laneSubject, and sessionId come from tools/call params for direct mutation commits. expectedRevision is always the canonical witness revision precondition. admissionId commits rehydrate the accepted admission target, verify the canonical revision still matches, verify ephemeral session fingerprints still match, then append mutation and resolution evidence only. Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.admit_mutation.summary", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.admit_mutation.summary", "about", "admit_mutation")

("sem.admit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is { proposalId: string }; laneSubject and sessionId come from tools/call params or the stored proposal target metadata, never tool arguments. ("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "about", "commit_mutation")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "about", "commit_mutation")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is exactly one of { mutation: object } or { admissionId: string }. actor, expectedRevision, laneSubject, and sessionId come from tools/call params for direct mutation commits. expectedRevision is always the canonical witness revision precondition. admissionId commits rehydrate the accepted admission target, verify the canonical revision still matches, verify ephemeral session fingerprints still match, then append mutation and resolution evidence only. Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")

Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")

Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "isa", "SemanticDoc")

("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "kind", "summary")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "order", "1")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "about", "commit_mutation")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is exactly one of { mutation: object } or { admissionId: string }. actor, expectedRevision, laneSubject, and sessionId come from tools/call params for direct mutation commits. expectedRevision is always the canonical witness revision precondition. admissionId commits rehydrate the accepted admission target, verify the canonical revision still matches, verify ephemeral session fingerprints still match, then append mutation and resolution evidence only. Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is exactly one of { mutation: object } or { admissionId: string }. actor, expectedRevision, laneSubject, and sessionId come from tools/call params for direct mutation commits. expectedRevision is always the canonical witness revision precondition. admissionId commits rehydrate the accepted admission target, verify the canonical revision still matches, verify ephemeral session fingerprints still match, then append mutation and resolution evidence only. Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.mcp.semanticDocCreateFactsPolicy.note", "order", "2")
("sem.mcp.semanticDocCreateFactsPolicy.note", "text", "Accepted facts must contain one new SemanticDoc subject with exactly one isa SemanticDoc, about, kind, order, and text fact, plus optional unique seeAlso refs. Supported kinds are summary, meaning, note, diagnostic, example, and boundary. Extra predicates, duplicate subjects, malformed refs, duplicate seeAlso refs, empty text, and unsupported clusters are rejected before commit.")

("sem.admit_mutation.summary", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.admit_mutation.summary", "about", "admit_mutation")
("sem.admit_mutation.summary", "kind", "summary")
("sem.admit_mutation.summary", "order", "1")
("sem.admit_mutation.summary", "text", "admit_mutation runs semantic admission gates for a recorded proposal without committing it.")

("sem.admit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "about", "admit_mutation")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is { proposalId: string }; laneSubject and sessionId come from tools/call params or the stored proposal target metadata, never tool arguments. Accepted admissions return candidate delta, projection, typedProjection, target metadata, and admission evidence. Rejected admissions are normal MCP tool errors with admission evidence. Repeated calls for the same proposal return the existing admission without appending duplicate evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "about", "commit_mutation")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "kind", "summary")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "order", "1")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "text", "commit_mutation is a mutating host MCP tool that commits canonical or session-lane semantic mutations directly or from an accepted admission.")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "about", "commit_mutation")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is exactly one of { mutation: object } or { admissionId: string }. actor, expectedRevision, laneSubject, and sessionId come from tools/call params for direct mutation commits. expectedRevision is always the canonical witness revision precondition. admissionId commits rehydrate the accepted admission target, verify the canonical revision still matches, verify ephemeral session fingerprints still match, then append mutation and resolution evidence only. Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is exactly one of { mutation: object } or { admissionId: string }. actor, expectedRevision, laneSubject, and sessionId come from tools/call params for direct mutation commits. expectedRevision is always the canonical witness revision precondition. admissionId commits rehydrate the accepted admission target, verify the canonical revision still matches, verify ephemeral session fingerprints still match, then append mutation and resolution evidence only. Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")

Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "isa", "SemanticDoc")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "about", "commit_mutation")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is exactly one of { mutation: object } or { admissionId: string }. actor, expectedRevision, laneSubject, and sessionId come from tools/call params for direct mutation commits. expectedRevision is always the canonical witness revision precondition. admissionId commits rehydrate the accepted admission target, verify the canonical revision still matches, verify ephemeral session fingerprints still match, then append mutation and resolution evidence only. Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "about", "commit_mutation")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is exactly one of { mutation: object } or { admissionId: string }. actor, expectedRevision, laneSubject, and sessionId come from tools/call params for direct mutation commits. expectedRevision is always the canonical witness revision precondition. admissionId commits rehydrate the accepted admission target, verify the canonical revision still matches, verify ephemeral session fingerprints still match, then append mutation and resolution evidence only. Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "about", "commit_mutation")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is exactly one of { mutation: object } or { admissionId: string }. actor, expectedRevision, laneSubject, and sessionId come from tools/call params for direct mutation commits. expectedRevision is always the canonical witness revision precondition. admissionId commits rehydrate the accepted admission target, verify the canonical revision still matches, verify ephemeral session fingerprints still match, then append mutation and resolution evidence only. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "isa", "SemanticDoc")

("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "kind", "summary")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "order", "1")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "about", "commit_mutation")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is exactly one of { mutation: object } or { admissionId: string }. actor, expectedRevision, laneSubject, and sessionId come from tools/call params for direct mutation commits. expectedRevision is always the canonical witness revision precondition. admissionId commits rehydrate the accepted admission target, verify the canonical revision still matches, verify ephemeral session fingerprints still match, then append mutation and resolution evidence only. Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")

Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")

Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")

Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")

Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "isa", "SemanticDoc")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")

Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")

Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")

Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.admit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is { proposalId: string }; laneSubject and sessionId come from tools/call params or the stored proposal target metadata, never tool arguments. Accepted admissions return candidate delta, projection, typedProjection, target metadata, and admission evidence. Rejected admissions are normal MCP tool errors with admission evidence. ("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "isa", "SemanticDoc")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "about", "commit_mutation")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is exactly one of { mutation: object } or { admissionId: string }. actor, expectedRevision, laneSubject, and sessionId come from tools/call params for direct mutation commits. expectedRevision is always the canonical witness revision precondition. admissionId commits rehydrate the accepted admission target, verify the canonical revision still matches, verify ephemeral session fingerprints still match, then append mutation and resolution evidence only. Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")

Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.preview_mutation.summary", "text", "preview_mutation is a read-only host MCP tool that applies the semantic mutation engine against canonical witness facts or a published frontend session lane snapshot.")

("sem.preview_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.preview_mutation.note", "about", "preview_mutation")
("sem.preview_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.preview_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.preview_mutation.note", "text", "Input is { mutation: object }; laneSubject and sessionId come from tools/call params, not tool arguments. With no laneSubject it previews canonical state. Durable lanes preview canonical facts and may name an existing session snapshot for metadata. Ephemeral lanes require sessionId and preview the published session frontend facts. Output includes target lane/session metadata, candidate delta, projection, typedProjection, canonical revision, and diagnostics. Preview never appends witness, proposal, admission, mutation, resolution, or session snapshot records.")

("sem.mcp.semanticDocCreateFactsPolicy.summary", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.mcp.semanticDocCreateFactsPolicy.summary", "about", "mcp.semanticDocCreateFactsPolicy")
("sem.mcp.semanticDocCreateFactsPolicy.summary", "kind", "summary")
("sem.mcp.semanticDocCreateFactsPolicy.summary", "order", "1")
("sem.mcp.semanticDocCreateFactsPolicy.summary", "text", "The MCP createFacts policy accepts only a single SemanticDoc cluster and rejects arbitrary fact-batch authoring.")

("sem.mcp.semanticDocCreateFactsPolicy.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.mcp.semanticDocCreateFactsPolicy.note", "about", "mcp.semanticDocCreateFactsPolicy")
("sem.mcp.semanticDocCreateFactsPolicy.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.mcp.semanticDocCreateFactsPolicy.note", "order", "2")
("sem.mcp.semanticDocCreateFactsPolicy.note", "text", "Accepted facts must contain one new SemanticDoc subject with exactly one isa SemanticDoc, about, kind, order, and text fact, plus optional unique seeAlso refs. Supported kinds are summary, meaning, note, diagnostic, example, and boundary. Extra predicates, duplicate subjects, malformed refs, duplicate seeAlso refs, empty text, and unsupported clusters are rejected before commit.")

("sem.admit_mutation.summary", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.admit_mutation.summary", "about", "admit_mutation")
("sem.admit_mutation.summary", "kind", "summary")
("sem.admit_mutation.summary", "order", "1")
("sem.admit_mutation.summary", "text", "admit_mutation runs semantic admission gates for a recorded proposal without committing it.")

("sem.admit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "about", "admit_mutation")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is { proposalId: string }; laneSubject and sessionId come from tools/call params or the stored proposal target metadata, never tool arguments. Accepted admissions return candidate delta, projection, typedProjection, target metadata, and admission evidence. Rejected admissions are normal MCP tool errors with admission evidence. Repeated calls for the same proposal return the existing admission without appending duplicate evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "about", "commit_mutation")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "kind", "summary")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "order", "1")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "text", "commit_mutation is a mutating host MCP tool that commits canonical or session-lane semantic mutations directly or from an accepted admission.")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "about", "commit_mutation")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is exactly one of { mutation: object } or { admissionId: string }. actor, expectedRevision, laneSubject, and sessionId come from tools/call params for direct mutation commits. expectedRevision is always the canonical witness revision precondition. admissionId commits rehydrate the accepted admission target, verify the canonical revision still matches, verify ephemeral session fingerprints still match, then append mutation and resolution evidence only. Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "about", "commit_mutation")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is exactly one of { mutation: object } or { admissionId: string }. actor, expectedRevision, laneSubject, and sessionId come from tools/call params for direct mutation commits. expectedRevision is always the canonical witness revision precondition. admissionId commits rehydrate the accepted admission target, verify the canonical revision still matches, verify ephemeral session fingerprints still match, then append mutation and resolution evidence only. Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")

Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")

("sem.admit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "about", "admit_mutation")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.admit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is { proposalId: string }; laneSubject and sessionId come from tools/call params or the stored proposal target metadata, never tool arguments. Accepted admissions return candidate delta, projection, typedProjection, target metadata, and admission evidence. Rejected admissions are normal MCP tool errors with admission evidence. ("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "about", "commit_mutation")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "kind", "summary")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "order", "1")
("sem.commit_mutation.summary", "text", "commit_mutation is a mutating host MCP tool that commits canonical or session-lane semantic mutations directly or from an accepted admission.")

("sem.commit_mutation.note", "isa", "SemanticDoc")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "about", "commit_mutation")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "kind", "note")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "order", "2")
("sem.commit_mutation.note", "text", "Input is exactly one of { mutation: object } or { admissionId: string }. actor, expectedRevision, laneSubject, and sessionId come from tools/call params for direct mutation commits. expectedRevision is always the canonical witness revision precondition. admissionId commits rehydrate the accepted admission target, verify the canonical revision still matches, verify ephemeral session fingerprints still match, then append mutation and resolution evidence only. Repeated admission commits return existing committed evidence with alreadyCommitted true. Direct commits preserve the Phase 4A/4B behavior of appending proposal, admission, mutation, and resolution evidence.")
